summary: Iter172 — Independent end-to-end validation of the 'Programmer les tendances et raccourcis par zone' feature. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass on /app/backend/tests/test_iter172_zones_api.py (admin auth guards return 401 on all 6 admin endpoints; admin list returns 3 seeded zones Pointe-à-Pitre/Fort-de-France/Dakar with shortcut_count integers; full zone CRUD POST→PUT→DELETE with cookie auth; programmed shortcuts GET/PUT replaces entries and count reflects in list; create-zone validates required name returns 400; /resolve geo match Pointe-à-Pitre lat/lng works; /resolve label match Dakar by 'Plateau, Dakar, Sénégal' works; /resolve no-match returns null zone + empty shortcuts; /resolve schedule Fri 19:00 includes Bars and Mon 19:00 excludes Bars while Taxi VTC stays). Also re-ran existing unit suite /app/backend/tests/test_zones.py — 11/11 pass. Frontend admin (Playwright on /admin/zones logged in as admin@superapp.com via 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → email login): sidebar 'CONTENU (CMS) > Écran accueil app > Zones & raccourcis' loads admin-zones-page; 3 seeded rows visible (Pointe-à-Pitre 3, Fort-de-France 2, Dakar 2). Create flow: add-zone-btn opens zone-dialog → filled zone-name/city/lat/lng/radius → zone-save created TEST_UI_ZoneIter172 → row appeared. Program flow: program-<id> opens program-dialog → add-service-btn opens service-picker (29 pickable services from CMS+taxi modes) → first pick added entry-0 → sched-enabled-0 reveals Lun-Dim toggles (day-0-0..day-0-6) + start/end time → toggled Friday (day-0-5) + 18:00-23:59 → program-save persisted and program-<id> button now shows '1'. Edit flow: edit-zone-<id> reopens dialog, name updated with '_upd' suffix persisted in row. Delete flow: delete-zone-<id> + window.confirm accepted → row removed, toast 'Zone supprimée'. Best-effort /home check: not logged-in client redirects to landing (expected); no zone-related JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/zones.py is well-structured (~330 lines, single responsibility, doctring header). resolve_zone correctly prioritises geo→hierarchy/alias text→null. _entry_active handles overnight windows (start>end) correctly. _haversine_km used for geo radius check. No mongo _id leakage (uses {'_id': 0} projection everywhere and _clean helper).

AdminZones.js (~340 lines) — clean state machine with editing/programming/pickerOpen; all interactive elements have data-testid (add-zone-btn, zone-name/country/region/city/lat/lng/radius/aliases/order/active, zone-save/cancel, program-<id>, add-service-btn, service-picker, pick-<id>, entry-<idx>, up/down/remove-<idx>, sched-enabled-<idx>, day-<idx>-<v>, start/end-time-<idx>, program-save/cancel, edit-zone-<id>, delete-zone-<id>, zone-row-<id>). Uses sonner toast for success/error.

MINOR: delete uses window.confirm — works but not consistent with shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere in the admin panel. Same pattern was flagged in iter171 for AdminNearbyBusinesses (precedent). Low priority.

MINOR: catalog dedupe in AdminZones.js uses path as key (line 62-64) which correctly prevents duplicate taxi+CMS entries, but two distinct CMS items pointing to the same target_route would be silently dropped. Not a bug for current data, just noting.
Admin endpoints correctly gated by require_permission('content.manage') (returns 401 unauth, verified). Cookie auth (access_token) used consistently.
test_credentials: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! (cookie auth via /login → 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' → login-email-btn → email-input/password-input/email-login-submit-btn)
seed_data_creation: Created+deleted 1 transient zone per pytest run (TEST_ZONE_Iter172) and 1 per UI run (TEST_UI_ZoneIter172) — both cleaned up by same test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter172 feature verified end-to-end. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter172_zones_api.py covers all admin auth guards, full zone CRUD, programmed shortcuts CRUD with count assertion, and /resolve in all four modes (geo, label, no-match, schedule day/time filter). UI test pattern: must dismiss welcome modal ('Continuer'), then click 'Ou choisir une autre option de connexion' link before login-email-btn data-testid is available. data-testid list confirmed working: admin-zones-page, add-zone-btn, zone-row-<id>, zone-dialog, zone-name/country/region/city/lat/lng/radius/aliases/order/active, zone-save, zone-cancel, program-<id> (also shows count text), program-dialog, add-service-btn, service-picker, pick-<id> (where id is 'pick-taxi','pick-airport',etc or CMS item id), entry-<idx>, up/down/remove-<idx>, sched-enabled-<idx>, day-<idx>-<v> (v=0..6 with 0=Sun, 5=Fri per JS getDay), start-time-<idx>, end-time-<idx>, program-save, edit-zone-<id>, delete-zone-<id>. Delete uses window.confirm — accept via page.on('dialog'). No regressions in other zone-related suites (test_zone_pricing.py, test_iteration_152_zone_app_settings.py — not re-run but unaffected by this feature).
rca of the issue: N/A — feature is functional end-to-end on both backend and admin frontend. Client-side merge of zone-programmed shortcuts on /home not tested because geolocation does not resolve to a seeded zone from the test environment (Iowa IP, as flagged in the review request).
